Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Riveo's What's New showcase - swiping between feature slides (Time Range Selection, Beat Edits, Animate Styles, Select Multiple Overlays, Resizable Canvas) triggers a 3D holographic page-peel: the current page's corner lifts with a rainbow-foil sheen and peels diagonally off to reveal the next.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark showcase: each slide has a small rainbow "What's New" tag, a bold title, a centered screenshot of the video-editor feature (timeline, grid picker, WOAH title styles, color overlays), a caption line, page dots, and prev/next arrows.

## Motion spec
Pattern: holographic page-peel carousel.
- Swipe: the current slide's far corner lifts and curls with the drag - the peel follows the finger diagonally, the page bending like film stock; the underside of the peel shows a shifting rainbow holographic foil that shimmers with the peel angle.
- The next slide is revealed underneath as the peel exposes it - it scales up slightly (0.97 -> 1) as more of it shows.
- Release past ~40%: the peel flies off with momentum (600ms, ease-out, curl tightening) and the new slide settles flat; below threshold the page uncurls back flat (spring ~280/22).
- Page dots slide their fill on commit; the caption crossfades with the title.

## Calibration
- The holographic foil appears ONLY on the curling underside - flat pages are matte.
- Peel direction is constant (top-right corner, peeling toward bottom-left) regardless of swipe direction sign.

## Reduced motion
Slides crossfade with a slight scale; no peel.

## Don't miss
- The curl is 3D: the page surface deforms, with soft shadow under the lifted region.
- Each slide's screenshot is the feature mid-use - real editor chrome, not marketing art.
